title: feat(insights): enable default click events on hits and infinite hits
body:
This sets up default click events on hits and infinite hits in InstantSearch.js and React InstantSearch Hooks.

Similar to what was done when we introduced VDOM templating, I created new test suites for the widgets that don't rely on Enzyme. We can progressively migrate the other tests, which will eventually converge when we start putting UI components in common.
